test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

The news about the surge in Covid-19 cases __is broadcasted__ every morning.
solution:
The correct answer is **'is broadcast'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part of the given sentence has **an error in tense form. **
 
• The underlined part uses the **past tense form broadcasted** to talk about daily news. 
 
• This is incorrect as **daily news broadcast happens in the present **and **'broadcasted' **is also an incorrect English word. 
 
• **Broadcast **is the same in the **present tense and the past tense.**
 
• So, the underlined part is best improved by the **present tense form broadcast. **
 
• Since, **news is singular, **to maintain subject-verb agreement, we take the** singular linking verb is. **
 
• Thus, **option 3 **or **is broadcast **is the best option to improve the underlined part.

***Correct sentence - ****The news about the surge in Covid-19 cases** ****is broadcast__**** **every morning.*
